profile.title: Profile

profile.guestBody: Explore freely. We ask you to sign in only when you are ready to design a room.
profile.tasteNone: Tell us what you like and what you want to spend. It takes a minute.

error.title: Something went wrong

import.body: Already have photos or a video of the room? Use them to get a redesign and a shopping list.
import.tipWalls: Show every wall, from the floor up.

import.estimated: Sizes from photos are estimates. Scan the room, or measure it, to confirm what fits.

review.question: Happy with the view and lighting?

consent.title: Before you start

points.photos: Your photos and scans go to Sajao to measure your room and make its designs.
points.people: Keep people and private things out of frame.
points.delete: You can delete your account and everything kept for it from Profile at any time.

consent.agree: By continuing you agree to the privacy policy and terms.
